brava-security-2026.tagline: Exposing blind spots in SOC detection with virtual evidence

founders.background: A graduate of the Israel Defense Forces' elite Talpiot intelligence unit. Spent 10 years in threat research at Unit 8200, then served as Product Management Lead for Microsoft Defender.
Led high-speed engineering organizations (VP R&D) for 14 years. Directed a joint DARPA-Israel AI research program and has experience building autonomous AI systems and enterprise AI security.

brava-security-2026.team_highlights: Co-founders from Israel's elite Talpiot and Unit 8200 intelligence units. Approximately 20 employees, with R&D in Tel Aviv and commercial organization in the US.

product.summary: Brava models attacker behavior to generate precise telemetry (virtual evidence) that a real attack would leave in a specific environment. Using this 'Ground Truth,' it is an AI-driven security operations platform that proactively verifies whether existing SIEM detection rules work, checks data pipeline integrity, and automates fixes.
product.problem_statement: Security teams cannot be sure their current defenses will detect a specific attack. Due to missing logs, pipeline outages, or malfunctioning detection rules, they are forced to rely on 'hope.' There is no way to know about attacks that even AI agents cannot detect.
product.solution: A multi-agent AI system models attacker behavior and generates environment-specific telemetry. It streams this virtual evidence into the SIEM to prove whether detection rules fail silently, log sources are down, or schemas have changed. All findings cite actual raw events.
key_features: Detection Engineering: Tests each detection rule against the corresponding attack and automatically rewrites it in the SIEM query language, then verifies operation.
AI Investigation Agent 'Aquarium': Allows unified investigation of SIEM, EDR, and cloud audit logs using natural language questions, generating citable reports.
Data Pipeline Optimization: Sends only necessary events to the SIEM and moves unnecessary logs to low-cost storage, reducing SIEM costs by 65-85%.
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: A multi-agent AI system that synthesizes accurate digital evidence (telemetry) through attacker behavior modeling without executing attacks. Integrates with over 70 sources and destinations.
product.target_customer: Fortune 100 companies and large enterprises (retail, energy, hospitality, finance, government). SOC teams with existing SIEM deployments.
product.business_model: B2B SaaS. Operates as a layer on top of existing security stacks; no additional hardware replacement required.

direct_competitors.comparison: Centered on BAS (Breach and Attack Simulation) that executes predefined attack scenarios. Brava generates virtual telemetry to continuously validate the fundamental functionality of data pipelines and detection rules.
Provides AI-based investigation and SOAR capabilities but leans toward 'post-incident analysis.' Brava is a 'pre-validation' layer that proves the detection system itself before an attack occurs.

competitive_landscape.key_differentiator: The only platform that generates environment-specific, accurate evidence (Ground Truth) without running actual attacks, mathematically proving the detection capability and data integrity of existing security stacks.
competitive_landscape.moat: Attacker behavior modeling and environment-specific telemetry synthesis technology; 10-15 minute onboarding; early market fit demonstrated with Fortune 100 customers.
competitive_landscape.competitive_position_summary: Creates a new category addressing the core SOC problem (distrust in the detection system). Positioned as a 'validation layer' that protects existing investments without SIEM replacement, maximizing security effectiveness.

product.summary: Roma is a to-do list app that automatically executes tasks when users register them. Users simply describe the task, and the AI interprets it, conducts research, drafts emails, coordinates schedules, and more in the background, presenting the completed output.
product.problem_statement: Traditional to-do lists only record 'what needs to be done' without helping with actual execution. AI assistants disperse tasks, leading to context loss and causing users to waste time tracking progress.
product.solution: Roma retains the familiar to-do list format while offering a 'self-executing to-do list' where AI understands the task's intent and integrates with tools like Gmail, Calendar, Notion, etc., to execute it.
key_features: When tasks are registered via natural language or voice, AI automatically organizes and begins execution.
In Operator mode, utilizes context from connected apps like email, calendar, and files.
Integrates with external AI agents such as Claude, Codex, and Cursor through MCP.
Summarizes task progress and notifies users at decision points.
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: AI operates as an agent that plans, executes, and reports on tasks in multiple steps, rather than a simple reactive assistant. Supports MCP (Agent Communication Protocol) for interoperability with external agents.
